ValidationRule.description: Validation to prevent selecting Discount Codes which are expired or not started yet
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED( Discount_Code__c ) ), Discount_Code__r.Valid_To__c < TODAY() ), AND( ISCHANGED(Discount_Code_In_Force__c), Discount_Code_In_Force__c = True, Discount_Code__r.valid_From__c > TODAY() ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: 1. Past discount code can't be accepted. 2. For selected future discount you can't set 'Discount Code In Force' to True.
